content.title: Methodology, with questions
content.body:
We trained the model on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.

For each task we used the [highlight]base Transformer model[/highlight] without any task-specific tuning, relying on [underline]attention dropout[/underline] and label smoothing instead.

Results on the WMT 2014 [circle]English-to-German[/circle] translation task are reported using BLEU and are averaged over five training runs.
